serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Huh? Someone is calling me on my cell phone… That’s rare.
I’m not really social, so getting a call is kinda surprising. Maybe Sammy wants to make up…
…
It’s mom… I guess it’s better than some snake oil salesman. 
You: Hi mom! Why are you calling?
Mom: Good evening honey! I just want to check on you. Are you doing well in the city? After breaking up with…
You: I’m doing fine mom! Jesus… Stop worrying so much. 
Mom: If you say so hun… I’m calling because… I heard from moms of your high school friends that you lost your job and I just…
You: M-mom! Don’t listen to these nosy women! I didn’t lose a job! I just… ehm… found a new one! T-these days you have to look for new opportunities, r-right? Even that white guy on the news said that!
Mom: Tuckey?! W-well, if he said it, it's probably true… What’s the name of this new company you work for?
You: Oh geez, I don’t remember hehe. Silly me. I will text it later, ok?
Mom: Alright. I’m sorry hun… I’m just worried, you know? You don’t call, you are not coming back home on holidays and after what happened to your papa I…
You: I got it, ok?! Geez… You see… New job is paying well, but it needs more commitment so I don’t have enough time.
Mom: Oh wow! How mature! Sometimes I forget that my baby is already a full fledged adult. I’m not gonna take more of your time then. If you could… {{wi}}Just call your mommy sometimes, ok? Being alone at home without you and dad is kinda lonely. Could you promise that to me? 
You: Sure mom! No prob! Bye Bye~
Mom: One more thing, I got a call from…
